review_notes: I read the whole file and searched Mathlib for competing versions of each declaration. The declarations checked were subtypeA, AffineSubspace.ofEq, ContinuousAffineEquiv.affineSubspaceMap, the IsTopologicalAddTorsor instance on an affine subspace, and isClosed_direction_iff. I found no existing ContinuousAffineMap subtype, ContinuousAffineEquiv ofEq, or topological-torsor instance for affine subspaces. isClosed_direction_iff has only one use, in Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Module/FiniteDimension.lean, and no earlier version of it exists. subtypeA is deliberately a continuous-affine-map counterpart of AffineSubspace.subtype. The other definitions are continuous versions of AffineEquiv.ofEq and AffineEquiv.affineSubspaceMap, and the file documents them as such. Mathlib/Analysis/Convex/Intrinsic.lean and Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Affine/Isometry.lean use them, and I found no parallel declaration that they replace. Both are intentional named specialisations, not avoidable duplicates. The only remaining uncertainty is that grep may miss renamed duplicates elsewhere.
